compiler_branches: JuMP and MOI compiler snapshots; GenOpt 0.2.5 compiler snapshot from the existing benchmark environment. Version numbers alone do not identify unmodified releases.
warmup: Each mode runs once at size 1000 before timing; GC.gc(true) runs before each Julia sample. Warmup, explicit pre-sample collection and disposal are excluded.
raw_scope: Reference arrays and native Highs_run. GenOpt modes retain hardcoded variable bounds and objective; reference row assembly is also included in setup.
grouped_scope: Complete existing grouped JuMP/GenOpt formulation and MOI.optimize! including result storage. The experimental adapters change row insertion, bound updates and variable block creation while preserving HiGHS.jl metadata.
validation: 1412 assertions, including every small-model native row coefficient, bounds, costs, optimum and result status across all ten paths; duplicate cancellation, constants, empty rows, batch boundaries, and HiGHS.jl variable/constraint metadata. All 15 temporary line markers executed and were removed.
phase_counters: Instrumented wall times; allocation-triggered GC is charged to its phase. Stock grouped mode has only total/setup/build/run measurements; missing CSV phase fields mean unmeasured, not zero.
integration: Experimental local adapter only; no installed package source or released JuMPy native library was changed.
